therapy_key.description: Echo back verbatim the therapy_key given for this therapy in the prompt.

canonical_name.description: Most recognizable canonical name for this therapy. Merge development codes and synonyms to the common name (e.g., 'MCI-186' and 'MT-1186' -> 'Edaravone').

aliases.description: Other names or development codes for this therapy seen across its trials.

target.description: Primary molecular/biological target (e.g., 'SOD1 mRNA', 'AMPA receptor'). Use 'Unknown' if it cannot be determined from the provided evidence.

mechanisms.description: All ALS mechanism classes this therapy is proposed to act through, each supported by a direct quote from the provided evidence. MULTI-LABEL: include every well-supported class. If the evidence does not establish any mechanism, return an EMPTY array (abstain) rather than guessing.

class.description: The mechanism class from the ALS taxonomy.

role.description: Whether this is the therapy's primary mechanism or a secondary/contributing one.

confidence.description: Confidence that this therapy acts through this mechanism, based ONLY on the provided evidence (1.0 = well-established, 0.4 = weak/inferred).

evidence_quote.description: A short verbatim quote from the provided evidence that supports this mechanism. Required — if you cannot quote supporting evidence, do not include this mechanism.
